policy_definitions.NARROW_DESTRUCTIVE: Reject only local ta-marbuta->ha or alif-maqsura->ya degradation; otherwise review.
policy_definitions.EVENT_STRUCTURAL_TYPED: Accept substitution-only complete events where every aligned token is one-N insertion/deletion or final-alif addition, event_cost <= 0.60, and no narrow destructive veto fires.
policy_definitions.EVENT_STRUCTURAL_STRICT: For one token use the same structural family with event_cost <= 0.25; for <=2-token multiword events accept only all-final-alif additions.

limitations: Rules were motivated by repeatedly inspected development evidence and are not production estimates.
Hamza corrections, lexical substitutions, speech-act/tense/person changes and word-boundary edits are review-only in this gate.
Scientific Integrity Guard and semantic fidelity verification still run after linguistic candidate acceptance.
No sealed benchmark and no Phase 3.
